title: OffSeq Mirage
description: Imports the OffSeq Mirage Feed, a free daily STIX 2.1 feed from the Mirage honeypot network (CC BY 4.0). It brings in attacker IPv4 indicators, payload and download URLs and payload file hashes, each with a confidence score and an expiry, plus the MITRE ATT&CK techniques and CVEs they are linked to. An address is listed only after at least 3 sensors in 2 networks saw it within 7 days, and expires 7 days after its last activity; research scanners and VPN/Tor exits are excluded. No API key is needed.
short_description: Imports the free OffSeq Mirage honeypot feed (attacker IPs, payload URLs and hashes, linked ATT&CK techniques and CVEs) into OpenCTI. No API key needed.
